subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When a finding ships, the reviewer shall emit it against the closed, versioned finding schema — which extends codegate's finding-grammar core (severity, location file:line, message, log-ref) with the review-only fields lens, calibration-row citation, and a mandatory dispute reason on any declined finding — and shall persist no free-form finding.
rationale: D-9: schema not prose, kin to codegate's so the host's fixer consumes one grammar family
fit_criterion: 100% of dogfood findings schema-validate and reuse codegate's core fields; a schema-invalid or reason-less-decline finding voids its round (UB-2); inspection confirms the shared core, review-only extensions, and zero codegate-schema change (NR-1)
